label: Social Media Team
blurb: A Head of Social with posts, video, design, community and partnerships
purpose: For a business whose customers live on social media. The Head of Social sets the plan; the team drafts posts, scripts short videos, makes graphics, looks after comments and messages, and finds collaborators.

project.name: Social Media
project.goal: Build a steady, engaged following that turns into customers.

members.title: Head of Social
members.name: Jade
focus: Own the two-week plan and approve every post before it reaches the person.

members.title: Social Media Manager
members.name: Luca
focus: Draft the planned posts for each platform and line them up for the person to approve.

members.title: Short Video Producer
members.name: Imani
focus: Script two short videos a week with hooks and captions.

members.title: Social Designer
members.name: Oscar
focus: Make graphics and thumbnails in the brand style.

members.title: Community Manager
members.name: Rosa
focus: Sort comments and messages daily and draft replies.

members.title: Creator Partnerships
members.name: Aiden
focus: Find creators and brands that fit, and draft outreach.
